title: helichrysum retusum
intro: Helichrysum retusum, commonly known as the yellow daisy or rock daisy, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family, native to South Africa. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and alleviating anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum retusum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds are believed to contribute to the plant's ability to promote relaxation, reduce pain and inflammation, and support overall well-being.
